## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

Automated textual analysis via DharmaNexus identifies 134 internal text-reuse passages shared with 59 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. A significant portion of the poem's opening verses (§1.1–6.4) corresponds closely to a passage in the commentary on the *Theragāthā* (*Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, Dutiyo bhāgo, §917–928), with further matches found in the commentary's first volume [DharmaNexus]. In addition, stock verses from §6 to §11 exhibit extensive formulaic reuse across the Therāpadāna itself, showing close parallels with texts such as the *Sucintitattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 430), the adjacent *Ekasaṅkhiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 434), the *Ekāsanadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 425), and the *Sovaṇṇakiṅkaṇiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 431) [DharmaNexus]. In cross-language alignments, DharmaNexus detects machine-generated correspondences with the Sanskrit *Maitreyavyākaraṇa* (§4.2–5.1) and the Tibetan translation of the *Acintyaprabhāsanirdeśa* (§1.3), though these represent formulaic parallels rather than curated textual parallels [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on catalog and DharmaNexus data.*
